2026 Commission Meeting Schedule

The dates listed below were approved by Commissioners on Wednesday, November 19 in West Sacramento, CA. Pending final agendas, the following meeting dates are scheduled for 2026.
 
Wednesday, February 25 and Thursday, February 26 (Santa Clarita, CA)
Commission Tour and Meeting
 
Tuesday, June 16 and Wednesday, June 17 (Bakersfield, CA)
Commission Workshop (Safety Summit) and Meeting
 
Thursday, August 6 and Friday, August 7 (Kings Beach, CA)
Commission Tour and Meeting
 
Wednesday, November 18 and Thursday, November 19 (Ocotillo, CA)
Commission Tour and Meeting
